name: xingularity-workspace-template-scaffold
description: Scaffold a new React workspace app from the internal Xingularity workspace template package.

interface.shortDescription: Bootstrap a new app from the Xingularity workspace shell and primitives.
interface.longDescription: Creates a starter React workspace app plus a local copy of the internal workspace-template package so later projects can reuse the sidebar, shell, vibrancy, primitives, and command-palette behavior.
capabilities: Scaffold a starter repo from the internal workspace package
Keep the starter and reusable primitives aligned
Reuse Xingularity shell layout, tokens, and shortcuts
interface.defaultPrompt: Scaffold a new project from the Xingularity workspace template.
